eips.title: Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation
eips.summary: Builder exit edge case in bid gossip: agreement to ignore bids from builders with an exit in the parent payload.

moments.context: Justin Traglia walked through a PR adding a check for a builder with an exit in the previous slot's payload, noting Nico's suggestion to simply ignore bids where a builder exit exists.
Nico Flaig said Lodestar runs the state transition on both blocks and would determine the builder block invalid that way.
Justin asked whether ignoring bids from exited builders would let someone submit an exit to prevent another builder being selected.

eips.title: Fork-choice enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL)
eips.summary: FOCIL gossip rule gains a non-empty transaction assertion, starting with a 4112 inclusion list size limit.

moments.context: Justin Traglia asked whether the updated inclusion list max size variable needed more discussion.
Jihoon said adding the non-empty assertion is not a big deal and they can start with the 4112 limit, and that he would clean up the spec PR and open a new engine API PR.
Justin asked about the fork-choice assertion; Jihoon said he was fine keeping it alongside the non-empty check and the peer-to-peer rule.
